entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Re-enable Build_ComponentApp_IncludesEmbeddedValidatableTypeAttributeForNet100 #55879
  • Add the cross-platform correctness and performance matrix #55876
  • Make archives and native installers effectively incremental #55875
  • Stabilize `GenerateSdkLayout` producers #55874
  • Make `OverlaySdkOnLKG` and cross-architecture overlays incremental #55873
  • Make crossgen and runtime-pack link replacement incremental #55872
  • Enable incremental `LayoutBundledComponents` #55871
  • Make workload metadata and root shims own stale outputs #55870
  • Make workload manifest layout own stale outputs #55869
  • Make SDK and MSI template layouts own stale outputs #55868
  • Add reusable redist incrementality infrastructure and tests #55867
  • Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs #55866
  • [.NET 9] InstallerBase NullReferenceException in dotnet --info and workload commands after supported repairs #55862
  • APICompat doesn't detect the addition of `required` on a public C# property as breaking #55860
  • Keep local validation fast enough for iterative agent use #55859
  • [AI discovered CI] [release/8.0.1xx] Signing fails to start sn.exe with Exec format error #55855

Closed

  • Reenable PublishingRegistersWrittenFilesForProperCleanup test once msbuild changes are unreverted again #50140
  • AppHost selection doesn't work well with DisableImplicitFrameworkReferences or RuntimeFrameworkVersion #3135
    Backlog
  • Explicit DocumentationFile=path instead of GenerateDocumentationFile=true leads to build race #1599
